about.description: NIKKEI225 is an index perpetual listed on BingX, tracking Nikkei 225 Stock Average, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
